title.narrative: UNICEF’s continued advocacy secured a US$31 million allocation from GoB to scale up Multiple Micronutrient Supplementation (MMS) for 6 million pregnant women under the 5th HNPSP. By integrating maternal nutrition services into PHC and linking them with social safety nets, UNICEF strengthened systems, improved equity, and advanced sustainable solutions for maternal and child nutrition.
